note: The plainclothes 'conditions' unit and off-duty cops. Menace through politeness. No slurs.

lines.text: Evening. Lovely evening.
You look familiar. You look like somebody I'll see again.
Busy street. Lots of commerce. We love commerce.
Lieutenant says the avenue's lively tonight. We'll see.
White sneakers? Comfortable. Nobody notices sneakers.
Collections are light this week. Somebody's not trying.
Special Prosecutor this, Special Prosecutor that. Special headache.
Rain. Everybody indoors. Bad for business.
Roll the window up. We can see fine from here.
Hot night. People get careless when it's hot.
Keep honking. I've got all night and a notebook.
You bumped me. That's assault, technically. Lucky I'm nice.
Easy, friend. Wouldn't want to drop anything.
Somebody's in a hurry. Follow him. No, walk.
Run all you want. The avenue's only so long.
Nice driving. I'll remember the plate.
Lights out. Everybody's honest in the dark, right?
Two a.m. The real city's out now.
If Bauer's nervous, somebody's talking. Find out who.
Fifty's a tax. Seventy-five is a tax with a smile.
Shine your shoes, Earl? No? Shame. They need it.
Ricky says the park's quiet. Ricky says a lot of things.
The Commission was weather. Weather passes.
Camera? Who's got a camera on this avenue? Find it.
Delphine. Always a pleasure. Always.
Write it up as a disorderly. Disorderly's always true.
Coffee? We don't take coffee anymore. We take envelopes.
Watch the jacket. It's leather. In July. On purpose.
He's running toward Penn Station. They always do.
Rain washes the avenue. Not clean. Just wet.
Lieutenant's boat needs a new motor. Collections go up.
Small world. Smaller every time I see you.
You did us a favour on Thirty-Fourth. Don't make it a habit.
Your face is on a card in my pocket. Want to see it?
Keep walking. I'm not working. Yet.
You shot up my sector. That's personal now.
Don't. Don't even think it. There's two more of us across the street.
